blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Veteran journalist Philip Lustre Jr. said his arrest over the weekend had a procedural flaw and was an operation that specifically targeted him. The arrest has led lawyers to warn that it could create a climate of fear among the press as they called anew for decriminalizing libel. “It was definitely a special operation against me,” Lustre said on social media on Sunday. He added that the move seemed intended to have him arrested on a Saturday and detained over the weekend, when securing bail could be difficult. “There was a procedural flaw in the process.
